entities.summary: Dalia Rabin-Pelossof is an Israeli former politician. The daughter of former Prime Minister and Minister of Defense Yitzhak Rabin, she served as a member of the Knesset for the Center Party, New Way and the Labor Party between 1999 and 2003.
